# Custom Error Types and thiserror
In production services, domain errors are structured into custom enums:

```rust
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum ServiceError {
    InvalidInput(String),
    NetworkTimeout,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for ServiceError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{:?}", self)
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for ServiceError {}

fn main() {
    let err = ServiceError::InvalidInput("Missing header".into());
    println!("Service error: {}", err);
}
```
